precedent.body: Mandatory substitution applies even if the card itself would also be destroyed

en.answer:
The『If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead』effect of <<7298>> is an effect that must always be applied, so even in a situation where the equipped monster and this card would be destroyed at the same time, this effect will still be applied, and the monster that is equipped with <<7298>> won't be destroyed and will remain in the Monster Zone.

~~~
